page.content:
Kaeneus was described as the daughter of Elatus, a Lapith leader and Hippea. In other version, Kaeneus was described as the daughter of Atrax, the son of the river god Peneus and Bura.

page.overview:
Who is Kaeneus?

Kaeneus the son of Koronus from Gortyn was one of two Argonauts that bore the name (the other being the child of Elatus and Hippea). The exact amount of Kaeneus' involvement in the Quest for the Golden Fleece is unknown because he is onlly mentioned by name in the part where the Argonauts assemble.

"Another Caeneus, son of Coronus, from Gortyn" Category:Argonauts
